writing_size.notes: size_norm = ref_h / ruling pitch (falls back to text-line pitch). Absolute mm only if cfg.dpi is set.
writing_size.rule: v = ref_h / ruling_pitch. score = min(1, d / 0.5) where d = distance of v outside the placeholder band [0.4, 1.6] (0 inside the band). Too small AND too large both score >0.

non_aligned_left_margin.rule: score = max over [std_norm: 0 at <= 0.15, 1 at >= 0.75], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

skewed_alignment.notes: Baseline = robust (Huber) line through word baseline points (Latin) or headline points (Devanagari). A single global ruling angle is the reference, so perspective differences between rulings add error.
skewed_alignment.rule: score = max over [mean_abs_rel_angle_deg: 0 at <= 1.0, 1 at >= 5.0; mean_rms_resid_norm: 0 at <= 0.08, 1 at >= 0.3], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

insufficient_word_spacing.notes: Words closer than word_gap_frac*ref_h are merged by the segmenter, so extremely tight spacing shows up as merged words (fewer gaps) rather than as small gaps.
insufficient_word_spacing.rule: score = max over [frac_gaps_narrow: 0 at <= 0.1, 1 at >= 0.5; median_gap_norm: 0 at >= 1.2, 1 at <= 0.6 (smaller is worse)], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

sharp_angles.notes: Corners at skeleton junctions are not counted; pen-lift stroke ends are not corners. Angular print-style letters (e.g. 'A', 'E', 'K', Devanagari matras) legitimately produce sharp angles.
sharp_angles.rule: score = max over [sharp_per_10_refh: 0 at <= 0.5, 1 at >= 3.0], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

broken_links.notes: Every extra connected piece inside a word counts as a break. BHK assumes cursive; print-style writing breaks by design. Ruling removal can also create artificial breaks where strokes sat on the line.
broken_links.rule: score = max over [breaks_per_word: 0 at <= 0.3, 1 at >= 2.0], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

collisions.notes: Proxy only: bounding-box overlap of distinct connected components. Letters that merge into ONE component (touching) cannot be separated without character identity -> manual review recommended.
collisions.rule: score = max over [collisions_per_main_comp: 0 at <= 0.02, 1 at >= 0.15], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

irregular_letter_size.notes: IQR/median of main-component heights per line (robust to a few ascenders). Cursive words are single components, so this is a word-level, not letter-level, size spread.
irregular_letter_size.rule: score = max over [mean_line_iqr_over_median: 0 at <= 0.25, 1 at >= 0.7], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

inconsistent_height_extensions.notes: Zones per word from the row profile; ascender/descender heights are compared across words.
inconsistent_height_extensions.rule: score = max over [xh_cv_no_ext: 0 at <= 0.1, 1 at >= 0.35; asc_ext_cv: 0 at <= 0.15, 1 at >= 0.45; desc_ext_cv: 0 at <= 0.15, 1 at >= 0.45], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

atypical_letter_forms.notes: REQUIRES REVIEW: deciding whether a form is atypical needs character identity. Shape-descriptor outliers (robust MAD z-score) are listed only as candidates for a human reviewer; no score is given.
atypical_letter_forms.rule: No automated score: the BHK item needs character identity / human judgement. Only descriptors and review candidates are reported.

ambiguous_letter_forms.notes: REQUIRES REVIEW: legibility/ambiguity of a letter cannot be decided without recognising it (and OCR is excluded by design). Components with extreme proportions and stray fragments are only candidates.
ambiguous_letter_forms.rule: No automated score: the BHK item needs character identity / human judgement. Only descriptors and review candidates are reported.

traced_corrected_letters.notes: Proxy: over-written strokes -> locally very thick ink; ink-filled loops -> tiny holes; erasures -> grey smudge away from ink. Heavy pen pressure or JPEG blur can mimic these.
traced_corrected_letters.rule: score = max over [thick_blobs_per_main_comp: 0 at <= 0.02, 1 at >= 0.2; tiny_holes_per_main_comp: 0 at <= 0.05, 1 at >= 0.4; smudge_fraction: 0 at <= 0.002, 1 at >= 0.03], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.

unstable_trace.notes: Stroke-width coefficient of variation along skeleton branches + count of alternating heading changes (tremor proxy). Static image only: no pen kinematics are available or used.
unstable_trace.rule: score = max over [width_cv: 0 at <= 0.25, 1 at >= 0.6; zigzag_per_refh: 0 at <= 0.3, 1 at >= 2.0], linear ramp in between. Anchors are placeholders.
